description: The system shall allow the SAT user to create new spots in a location.
The system shall allow assigning a name to each spot.
The system shall automatically assign the floor or allow creating new ones.
The system shall display the created spot automatically.
The system shall allow the SAT user to delete spots from a location.
The system shall prevent the deletion of a spot if it has assigned assets.
The system shall automatically remove the spot from the list upon deletion.
The system shall allow the SAT user to create assets assigned to a spot.
The system shall allow adding all asset and asset-type attributes to the asset.
The system shall automatically assign the spot, while allowing the user to decide which spot to assign.
The system shall allow leaving the serial number blank, to be assigned during installation.
The system shall allow the SAT user to delete assets from a spot.
The system shall automatically remove the asset from the list.
The system shall only allow deleting an asset if it is not assigned to an intervention.
The interface must follow the style and colors of the Waapiti platform.
All colors used in the interface must correspond to those defined in the Waapiti color palette included in the platform code.
The system must respond to any user action in less than five seconds.
The system responds to any user action in less than five seconds.
The system shall be developed using React for the frontend and NestJS for the backend.
The system shall use AWS cloud services for infrastructure.
